title: Constructing Predictive Surgical Path for AI-based Capsulorhexis Skill Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2608.21441v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated training of surgeons is one of the most crucial factors that significantly minimize surgical training risks and expenses. With recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) knowledge and available data from various surgeries, AI's involvement in surgical training is becoming very promising. It is recommended that at the early stages of AI development, it interferes in the surgery as a third agent alongside the trainer. As trust in AI increases, this process will lead to an AI agent acting as a trainer in the future. The first phase in which AI can intervene in the training process is to suggest an improved surgical path to the trainer. A platform must be constructed in the first step, to accomplish this task and to enhance the movement path of trainee surgeons. translated_title: 构建基于人工智能的连续环形撕囊技能转移的预测性手术路径
translated_abstract: 外科医生的自动化培训是显著降低手术培训风险和费用的最关键因素之一。随着人工智能（AI）知识的近期进展以及各种手术中可用数据的增加，AI在外科培训中的参与正变得非常有前景。建议在AI开发的早期阶段，它作为第三方代理与培训师一同参与手术。随着对AI信任度的增加，这一过程将引导AI代理在未来充当培训师。AI可以在培训过程中干预的第一阶段是向培训师建议改进的手术路径。必须首先构建一个平台，以完成此任务并增强受训外科医生的运动路径。本文介绍了该平台以及一个名为ARAS-Farabi数据集的带注释的连续环形撕囊手术数据集。在这项研究中，一个深度卷积神经...
tldr: 本文提出了一个用于AI辅助手术技能转移的平台，并引入了ARAS-Farabi数据集，以通过深度卷积神经网络构建预测性手术路径，从而增强受训外科医生的操作。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a platform for AI-assisted surgical skill transfer and presents the ARAS-Farabi dataset, using deep convolutional neural networks to construct predictive surgical paths that enhance trainee surgeons' movements.
